limits: These are nonpromotable benchmarks, not a new product release or deployment.
The warm repeat is 1661 seconds first-job-start to final-job-completion, not a guaranteed future release SLA.
The successful retry trial includes a deliberate fault, an unexplained ARM64 stall, cancellation and a retry. Do not use its whole-run percentage as a causal speedup.
Normal build cache proof is separate from the timing reporter, which does not infer cache state or isolated runner queue time.
The initial empty-cache sample uses a different source and version-ARG layout.
All hosted native measurements are bound to their stated SHA. Later documentation/reporting changes do not relabel those runs as qualification of a new SHA.
No stable aliases, version tags, GitHub Release or site deployment were changed.
